item.title: My Transition from Mathematics to Data Analytics
item.description:
As a PhD in Mathematics and Assistant Professor, I developed strong analytical and problem-solving skills. I am now transitioning into Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

I am learning:

• Python for data analysis
• SQL for data querying
• Machine learning fundamentals
• Data visualization

My goal is to apply mathematical and statistical knowledge to solve real-world data problems.
